In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Year" /> the exiled [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Adacin]] and [[Zanisk]] led an '''uprising''' against the [[Eternal Alliance]]. Tracking the renegades to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], the Alliance's [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] defeated the two and their forces.<ref name="INF" />
